lessons: The implementation is green: 684 tests pass and the diff is only the two fenced tests with no tickets/ path. Keep tests/test_phase2_exit.py and tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py as they are. Do not rewrite them to chase this gate.

The failure was in the engine's Check requisition review, not in the code. The reviewer started its reply with prose ('Approve: all three seeds...') before the JSON. RequisitionReply.model_validate_json(unwrap_fence(text)) then failed with one json_invalid error.

The requisition reviewer must reply with ONLY the JSON object {verdict, summary, findings}: no prose before or after it, and findings empty exactly when the verdict is approve. Its approve content was valid; only the leading text broke the parse.

Do not touch any seed's ticket.md, and do not hand-write tickets/phase2-exit/checks.json. Check must record an approve for main's current blob of all three seeds itself, which needs a clean schema-valid review reply.

If the same leading-prose failure repeats, file a Suggestion Box ticket for requisition.py: make it extract the trailing JSON object or re-ask on an invalid reply. Do not fold that fix into this branch.
